title: Bhubaneswar · stone, food and painted streets

items.notes: Begin slowly. Ask about the return pickup and a quiet place for lunch.
Look at the gateway. Ask before photographing worshippers.
Ask which vegetables are used today.

Compare the stupa with the rock-cut elephant.
Confirm steps, drop-off and toilets before travelling.
Read the 2009 photographs as an archive. Do not assume the murals still survive.
